decision: Wave44 establishes that all three valid deployment-feasible depth-32 planners are destructive: each has 0/32 exact recoveries and negative normalized edit-distance improvement, although GAR is less destructive than random. Do not seed-scale or interpret this as successful planning. Recover only the failed wave45 validity experiment: collect depth-1-to-4 target-free frozen-GAR states with the now-shared, tested deployable proposal generator, then train the matched 50/50 expert/replay hard-latent EMA pilot. Promote replay only if first-step true advantage remains positive, decisions 2-4 and full normalized edit-distance improve over the expert-only parent, and representation health does not collapse. Otherwise reject expert-state coverage as the primary explanation and stop scaling the present GAR planner. Replay goal buffers are terminal-privileged training labels only; proposal generation, behavior actions, GAR scoring, and selection remain target-free.
